title: SmokHot
engine: Front end: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
coverAlt: SmokHot cover board: a hot-sauce e-shop with a desktop and a mobile screen of the home page.
brief: The client produces and sells hot pepper sauces in Serbia and needed a website with a shop, with payment on delivery. The brief asked for something attractive, interactive and unmistakably rock and roll.
summary: E-shop for a Serbian hot-sauce brand: 10 products, 6 languages, payment on delivery.
